enable_js.other: Enable JavaScript to submit these forms securely.

choose_section.other: Choose a permitted section from navigation.

no_sections.other: No administration sections are permitted for this account.

input_invalid.other: Check the input and try again.

session_expired.other: Your session expired or could not be verified. Sign in again.

permission_denied.other: You do not have permission for this operation.

record_conflict.other: The record changed or conflicts with this request. Look it up before another change.

outcome_unknown.other: The outcome could not be confirmed. Do not repeat the change automatically. Inspect the account or image library before another change.

password_length.other: Check the password length in characters (at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes).

login_missing.other: No account matched the exact login. Check the retained login before another creation attempt.

service_unavailable.other: The service is unavailable. A read can be attempted again; no change was submitted.
